en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a wide urban street scene with several- to many-story buildings in early 20th‑century European style. People walk along the street and sidewalks; there are shopfronts at ground level. On the right is a rounded corner building with balconies and a large socialist‑style mural or poster of a worker holding a hammer. In the upper right corner of the card is Cyrillic text.
